note: One reading per UTC day, taken at roughly the same wall-clock time each day (~00:30 JST) — a fixed-time slice, NOT the day's peak. Steam counts only players who launched through Steam, so mobile, PlayStation and standalone-launcher players are not included and the figure is a floor. Valve publishes only the current count, so history begins when this scrape did and cannot be backfilled.
